slides.texte_overlay:
How to become
impossible to manipulate
Know your own values clearly. Write down what you will and won't accept. When you know your lines, nobody can slowly push you past them without you noticing.
Take time before big decisions. "Let me think about it until tomorrow." Pressure to decide right now is the oldest trick there is. A calm pause breaks it.
Watch actions, not words. Kind words with unkind actions tell you everything. Trust what people do over time, not what they promise in the moment.
Be comfortable saying no. A clear "No, thanks" without a long explanation. People who need to justify every refusal are much easier to pressure and push around.
Keep learning how people think. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and history is full of lessons about persuasion that make you harder to fool.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. History is full of persuasion lessons that make you harder to fool.

slides.texte_overlay: Keep strong friendships outside any one relationship. People who isolate you from friends gain control. A wide circle of support keeps you clear-headed.
Trust your gut when something feels off. You don't need proof to step back. A quiet "this doesn't feel right" is often your mind noticing what you haven't yet.
